summary.intent: Finalize phase 43 (FUSE write durability) for merge: verify all critical review findings are resolved, run simplify, ship the PR, and address all automated review feedback until the branch is merge-ready.
summary.outcome: PR #487 opened and fully cleaned up — CR-03/CR-04 fixed, 3 simplify cleanups applied, 6 deferred todos captured, codecov wired for Rust crates, sync edge-trigger extracted with 8 unit tests, all CodeRabbit inline threads and body comments resolved, 2 additional bugs caught post-PR fixed.

repo: After `gh pr create`, `github-actions[bot]` (release-please) immediately pushes a `chore(release): set release targets` commit to the PR branch — the next local push gets rejected with 'remote contains work you do not have locally'; fix is `git fetch` then `git rebase origin/<branch>` before pushing.
The repo uses version tags for ALL 111 `uses:` action references (zero SHA pins) — this is a deliberate convention, not oversight; pinning only one action would be inconsistent.
Both the `patch` coverage check and the `desktop` flag in `codecov.yml` are `informational: true` (lines 62 and 69) — neither blocks merge despite the red UI.

Rust crates (fuse, sdk, crypto, etc.) were invisible to codecov because only `apps/**` and `packages/**` paths were tracked under the `desktop` flag. The workspace `cargo llvm-cov` already collected crate coverage — it was being discarded by the path filter, not absent.
The winfsp feature gate (`#[cfg(feature = "winfsp")]`) makes the Windows FUSE path not locally compilable on macOS; CI runs `cargo check --features winfsp` as the sole compile gate for that path.
`TrayStatus` derives `Debug, Clone, PartialEq` but deliberately omits `Eq`.
CodeRabbit 'outside of diff range' and 'nitpick' comments appear in the review body, not as resolvable inline threads — they cannot be resolved via the GraphQL `resolveReviewThread` mutation.
The `cargo fmt` convention is NOT enforced in CI; the codebase is not rustfmt-styled. Running `cargo fmt` would reformat the entire repo. Do not run it.
The GSD `/gsd:ship` preflight gate blocks on verification status anything other than `passed` (including `human_needed`). Must update `43-VERIFICATION.md` before shipping.
Commit subjects cannot contain parenthesized scopes at the end (`feat(fuse): ...` is fine; trailing parens are not) — enforced by `pr-title.yml` CI gate.

code.finding: CR-03 live bug: journal IPNS-key wrap fallback used `encrypted_ipns_for_tee.clone().unwrap_or_default()` (TEE-wrapped key) instead of empty string — replay cannot unwrap a TEE-wrapped key with the user's private key. Fixed to warn + `String::new()`.

CR-03 same TEE-key fallback bug on the winfsp path. Also used `cipherbox_crypto::wrap_key` while the rest of the file uses `cipherbox_crypto::ecies::wrap_key` — cosmetic inconsistency (same fn via re-export) fixed in the simplify pass.
CR-03 parent IPNS key wrap failure was swallowed via `.ok()` → empty key with no log, breaks replay publish. Hardened to warn-on-failure with `String::new()` fallback.

TOCTOU race in idempotency guard: checked `sync_trigger` under a `read()` lock then stored the sender under a separate `write()` lock — two concurrent callers could both pass the check and each spawn a daemon. Fixed to collapse check-and-set into one `write()` critical section. Also silently swallowed poisoned lock; now propagates as `Err`.
`WriteParked` was missing from `is_connected()` — so the Logout tray menu item was disabled for an authenticated user whose uploads are just parked. Fixed by adding `WriteParked` to the match arm.

`depth` / `MAX_RESOLVE_DEPTH` in `resolve_folder_key` misnamed — it counts nodes visited (breadth-first), not call-stack depth. Renamed to `nodes_visited` / `MAX_RESOLVE_NODES`. Straggler reference at line 1089 (error message) was missed on first rename pass and caused a compile error.

`journal_no_plaintext` test had a no-op assertion: `plaintext_probe` string was never actually inserted into the journal, so the `contains()` check always passed vacuously. Fixed to assert raw key bytes (`"wrappedkey"`) don't appear — verifies keys are stored hex-encoded.

Four pure free functions — `sanitize_error`, `regex_replace_paths`, `regex_replace_tokens`, `is_network_error` — have zero tests and 0% coverage. These are log-redaction helpers (security-relevant) that are trivially unit-testable without any harness.

The D-10 edge-trigger anti-spam logic (notify only when failed count increases; reset watermark on Idle) lived inline in a closure with no test coverage. Extracted to pure `bridge_status(status, prev_watermark) -> TrayBridgeOutcome` with 8 unit tests. The Syncing→watermark-preserved case was the key guard against re-arming the toast every poll.

workflow: When CodeRabbit re-finds a finding from the existing review doc live in code, trust it over commit messages that claim closure — commit messages like 'fix: close CR-04/08/07' do not guarantee the code change was correct.
Parallel verification sub-agents (one per critical finding, read-only) are effective for cross-checking multiple independent claims against current code without bloating context.

The `/simplify` four-agent pass (reuse / simplification / efficiency / altitude) reliably flags the same top issue from all four angles when the finding is real — strong convergence is a signal to apply, divergence is a signal to defer.
Deferred simplify items should be captured as todos immediately in the same session, with concrete file:line references and the reason for deferral, not left only in commit messages.
For YAML validation when python/pyyaml and the repo's node_modules aren't accessible, `ruby -ryaml -e 'YAML.load(File.read("file.yml"))'` works reliably.

Adding a second `codecov/codecov-action` upload step with a new flag is sufficient to surface already-collected crate coverage — no changes to the `llvm-cov` command are needed when it already runs `--workspace`.

The `gh api graphql resolveReviewThread` mutation requires the thread's global node ID (from GraphQL), while `gh api repos/.../pulls/.../comments` replies need the comment's database integer ID (from REST) — they're different identifiers.

friction: 1Password SSH signing failed twice with 'error: 1Password: failed to fill whole buffer / fatal: failed to write commit object' before the user manually restarted 1Password. Exit code 0 from the background task masked the failure on first detection.
Network timeout during push to github.com (75s) required a connectivity check (`curl`) and retry.

Push rejected after `gh pr create` because release-please bot pushed `chore(release)` to the branch before the next local push — required `git fetch` + `git rebase` to resolve (now saved to project memory).
`depth` rename in `lib.rs` missed the reference at line 1089 (error message string) on the first pass, causing a compile error that required a second read + edit.
Python `yaml` module unavailable; repo's `js-yaml` not accessible from the root via plain `node -e`; had to fall back to Ruby for YAML validation.

CodeRabbit outside-diff and nitpick comments (review body) cannot be resolved via the `resolveReviewThread` GraphQL mutation — required posting a summary reply comment and resolving manually, with no UI confirmation of resolution.
The `pr-body.md` Write call failed ('File has not been read yet') because the tool requires a prior Read before overwriting; had to use a different filename `pr-body-43.md`.
The combined commit-and-push Bash command didn't capture push output, leaving the branch appearing ahead-1 after what looked like a successful run — required a separate explicit push.
open_items: Consolidate fuser↔winfsp upload + mkdir journal-entry construction and UploadSpawnParams/spawn machinery into shared CipherBoxFS methods in crates/fuse/src/lib.rs (~150 lines of near-identical drifting code; security-sensitive D-04/D-05 ordering must be preserved; winfsp path not locally compilable).

Replace empty-string sentinel for missing journal IPNS keys with `Option<String>` uniformly and a `wrap_ipns_key_for_journal` helper — `parent_ipns_key_hex` uses empty-string while `file_ipns_key_hex` already uses `Option`, inconsistent within one struct.

Extract shared journal-dir path (`<data_local_dir>/cipherbox/cb-journal`) + `DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES` (magic value 5) triplicated across fuse/mod.rs, fuse/windows/mod.rs, and commands/sync.rs — a CR-07 footgun where the sync daemon and FUSE mount must point at the same directory.

Have `replay_upload_entry` delegate to `operations::publish_file_metadata` and extract a shared `cas_publish_parent` helper — replay currently re-inlines ~70 lines of publish logic (3rd copy across write_ops.rs, windows/write_ops.rs, and lib.rs).

Memoize `resolve_folder_key` during `replay_for_vault` — currently re-walks the vault tree from root for every replayed entry, making mount-time replay latency super-linear when multiple queued entries share a parent folder.

Replace `e.to_lowercase().contains("not found")` in replay first-publish detection with a typed `Result<Option<u64>>` or `NotFound` variant from `coordinator.resolve_sequence` — a reworded error silently flips the branch. Larger scope: touches PublishCoordinator and 9 call sites.

Improve phase-43 Rust test coverage: Tier 1 quick wins in `crates/sdk/src/sync.rs` (4 pure log-redaction functions, 0% coverage); Tier 2 `lib.rs` replay + FUSE callbacks (need trait seams, enabled by the consolidation refactor); Tier 3 Tauri glue (accepted gap, covered by headless UAT).

Pin all GitHub Actions `uses:` references to immutable SHAs and enable Dependabot for `github-actions` ecosystem — 111 references across 6 workflow files currently use mutable version tags. Dependabot pairing is required to avoid freezing on stale versions.
